notes: Target values, initial facts and final updates are fixed across length/load conditions within each seed.
Control and treatment each append one equal-template assignment to different accounts.
Distractors never write the target or protected account, and never contain their answer values.
Entity load varies independently from update count; report observed unique entities as well as pool size.
Frozen-model diagnostic only; evidence from the whole hybrid is not proof of recurrent-state integrity.
